verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
ENNAKU bwe zifumita
Omwoyo gw'omuntu
Omu,eyafumitibwa
Ye-anyita ekiwundu.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Omwoyo bwe gunyolwa-ennyo,
-Amaziga ne gajja,
Ayinza-omu,eyanyolwa,
Okugusanyusa.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
-Ebibi bwe tubijjukira
Ebitanaazika;
Omugga gumu-,ogw'omusaayi,
Guyinza-okunaaza.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ogwa Yesu gwe gunaaza
Gunaaliza ddala;
Era y'ayinza-okunyiga
N'okutusanyusa.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Kale,otusanyusa Yesu
-Otunyige-ebiwundu
-Otunaaze n'omusaayi gwo
Ogunaaza gwokka.
